text: For D332899 at revision 156a4626b6815b249151bddb99cb079f5393b220, the AI source review reports that a calendar becoming unwritable before Save retains the draft and marks the selector invalid, but gives no visible explanation: the Save renderer handles event-save-failed, while calendar validation reports event-validation-failed. For this dialog, check localized feedback linked to the selector as well as its invalid state. Suggested coverage includes retained values, no transaction, and cleared feedback after a valid retry. A local change was reported applied but not accepted. Focused static checks reportedly passed; the browser test was not run because matching binaries were unconfirmed. This is a scoped source-review claim, not runtime confirmation or a general accepted UI convention.
title: Calendar Save validation needs visible feedback
